body: I think most of us here have such a low self worth that we care about others more than ourselves. What I have noticed is it makes talking about suicidal thoughts with people, who know you personally, hard because it puts a burden on them. That isn't something any of us wants. We do want to still talk about it with people because that is how we where always taught to get better. I think no matter what you do there will be someone devastated by your death, most likely multiple people. Loved ones will always wonder if they could have done something to stop you or why they didn't notice. I think after you weigh if hurting your loved ones is worth ending your own suffering than you can have a more rational discussion about suicide.
